description: This file defines the Base64VLQ class implementing Base64 VLQ encoding and decoding, used in source map generation, within the SCSSPHP project.

classes.name: Base64VLQ
classes.description: Provides static methods for encoding and decoding VLQ values using Base64, used in source map processing.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes an integer value into a VLQ Base64 string.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a VLQ Base64 string into an integer value.

methods.name: toVLQSigned
methods.description: Converts a signed integer to a VLQ-signed integer.

methods.name: fromVLQSigned
methods.description: Converts a VLQ-signed integer back to a signed integer.
